name: Microsoft

eyebrow.en: Microsoft Corporation · Common stock · Redmond, Washington
eyebrow.zh: 微软 · 普通股 · 华盛顿州雷德蒙德

title.en: Azure accelerates, and the cash still flows.
title.zh: Azure 加速，现金照样流入。

lede.en: Microsoft grew revenue 19% to $92.3B last quarter as Azure, now reported in dollars, rose 48% to $33.2B, and it guides Azure to 49–50% next. Unlike most AI spenders it still produces free cash flow, $18.6B last quarter, even with $45.2B of capex including leases.
lede.zh: 微软上季营收增 19% 至 923 亿美元，Azure（现以美元金额披露）增长 48% 至 332 亿，下季 Azure 指引为 49–50%。与多数 AI 投资者不同，即使含租赁的资本开支达 452 亿美元，它上季仍产生 186 亿美元自由现金流。

s.zh: FY27 一致预期每股 $19.79 · GAAP 历史每股 $19.15，约 28 倍
FY27 Q2 增速，按固定汇率

s.en: Q2 FY27 · date not yet announced
s.zh: FY27 第二季 · 日期未公布

sub_price.en: Daily closes with the 50-day average. The stock ranged from about $349 to $554 over the past year.
sub_price.zh: 每日收盘价与50日均线。过去一年股价在约 $349 至 $554 间。

sub_rev.en: Revenue in US$ millions, with gross margin on the right axis. Microsoft's fiscal year ends June 30. Some GAAP EPS figures include OpenAI-related items. The last bar is guidance at the midpoint.
sub_rev.zh: 营收单位为百万美元，右轴为毛利率。微软财年截至6月30日。部分 GAAP 每股收益含 OpenAI 相关项目。最后一根柱为指引中值。

p.en: Azure grew 48% to $33.2B, beating the 44–45% guide, and is guided to 49–50% in the December quarter. Demand still exceeds supply.
p.zh: Azure 增长 48% 至 332 亿美元，超出 44–45% 的指引，12月季度指引为 49–50%。需求仍超供给。

p.en: Microsoft 365 Copilot daily users rose about 50% from last quarter; paid seats, over 30M in July, were not updated.
p.zh: Microsoft 365 Copilot 日活用户较上季增长约 50%；付费席位（7月时逾 3000 万）未更新。

p.en: Capex including leases was $45.2B, below the $50B+ guide as some third-party capacity slipped. Q2 should top $50B and spending speeds up in the second half; about 75% goes to short-lived chips.
p.zh: 含租赁资本开支 452 亿美元，因部分第三方产能交付推迟而低于逾 500 亿的指引。第二季预计超 500 亿，下半财年支出加速；约 75% 用于短寿命芯片。

p.en: Commercial RPO was $677B, up 73% but flat with June's $678B, and much of it is OpenAI.
p.zh: 商业剩余履约义务 6770 亿美元，同比增 73%，但与6月的 6780 亿持平，且很大部分来自 OpenAI。

p.en: Guide: revenue $96.0–97.1B, Azure 49–50% growth, capex over $50B.
p.zh: 指引：营收 960–971 亿美元，Azure 增 49–50%，资本开支超 500 亿。

p.en: Capex to accelerate in the second half; management expects positive free cash flow for the year.
p.zh: 下半财年资本开支加速；管理层预计全年自由现金流为正。

sources: Q1 FY27 results, Q2 guidance and call (CNBC)
Q1 FY27 call: Azure guide and capex (Yahoo Finance)
Price, market cap, consensus EPS and earnings date: Financial Modeling Prep, as of Oct 28, 2026

foot.en: Fundamentals as of Oct 28, 2026 (Q1 FY27 results). For information only, not investment advice. Not affiliated with Microsoft Corporation.
foot.zh: 基本面数据截至 2026年10月28日（FY27 第一季业绩）。仅供参考，不构成投资建议。与 Microsoft Corporation 无关联。

sub.en: Free cash flow is operating cash flow minus capital spending, in US$ millions, for the 20 quarters from Q2 FY22 to Q1 FY27. Microsoft's fiscal year ends June 30. Shaded bars and italic rows are estimates.
sub.zh: 自由现金流 = 经营现金流 − 资本开支，单位百万美元，涵盖 FY22 第二季至 FY27 第一季共 20 个季度。微软财年截至6月30日。浅色柱与斜体行为估算。

read.en: Microsoft has produced positive free cash flow in all 20 quarters, usually $15–25B, with a seasonal dip in the December quarter when taxes are paid. Cash capex more than doubled in two years, from $44.5B in FY24 to $115.9B in FY26, and was $39.4B in Q1 FY27, up 103%; free cash flow fell 27% to $18.6B but stayed positive as operating cash flow rose 29% to $58.0B.
read.zh: 微软 20 个季度自由现金流全部为正，通常 150–250 亿美元，12月季度因缴税季节性走低。两年内现金资本开支由 FY24 的 445 亿增至 FY26 的 1159 亿，翻倍有余；FY27 第一季为 394 亿，增 103%。自由现金流降 27% 至 186 亿美元，但因经营现金流增 29% 至 580 亿而保持为正。

read.en: Management expects over $50B of capex including leases in Q2 FY27, accelerating in the second half as delayed third-party capacity arrives, and says free cash flow will stay positive through FY27. I assume cash capex of $44–54B a quarter against operating cash flow of $45–66B, giving about $37B over four quarters, less than the roughly $47B that dividends and buybacks cost.
read.zh: 管理层预计 FY27 第二季含租赁资本开支超 500 亿美元，下半财年随延迟的第三方产能到位而加速，并称 FY27 自由现金流将保持为正。我假设每季现金资本开支 440–540 亿、经营现金流 450–660 亿，四季合计约 370 亿美元，低于股息与回购约 470 亿的支出。

p.en: $39.4B of cash capex in Q1 FY27; capex including finance leases was $45.2B, about 75% on short-lived chips.
p.zh: FY27 第一季现金资本开支 394 亿美元；含融资租赁资本开支 452 亿，约 75% 用于短寿命芯片。

p.en: About $7.3B a quarter after the raise to $0.98 a share.
p.zh: 上调至每股 0.98 美元后，每季约 73 亿美元。
FY27 第一季约 44 亿美元。

p.en: Operating cash flow of $58.0B in Q1 FY27, up 29%.
p.zh: FY27 第一季经营现金流 580 亿美元，增 29%。

p.en: $677B of commercial RPO, up 73% but flat with June.
p.zh: 商业剩余履约义务 6770 亿美元，同比增 73%，但与6月持平。

bridgeNote.en: Excludes debt maturities (Microsoft repaid $4.9B in Q1 FY27) and new borrowing, which management says it will use when attractive.
bridgeNote.zh: 未计入债务到期（FY27 第一季偿还 49 亿美元）及新增借款；管理层称会在条件有利时动用外部融资。

extraNote.en: Capex here is cash purchases of property and equipment; management's capex figure also includes finance leases.
extraNote.zh: 此处资本开支为物业与设备的现金购置；管理层口径另含融资租赁。
